title: The image of a quasi-compact algebraic space under a surjective morphism is quasi-compact
author: The Stacks Project Authors

difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma, opening with the slogan that the image of a quasi-compact algebraic space under a surjective morphism is quasi-compact, and proving two statements: a surjective morphism X -> Y with X quasi-compact has Y quasi-compact, and in a commutative triangle X -> Y -> Z with f surjective and p quasi-compact the morphism q is quasi-compact (source lines 1310-1331). The first part reduces to the topological fact that the image of a quasi-compact space under a continuous map is quasi-compact, using the definition of surjectivity on points and the characterization of quasi-compactness of an algebraic space; the second applies the first to the surjective base change T x_Z X -> T x_Z Y.
